caseStudies.title: SmartMoving: From Niche CRM to Operations Platform
caseStudies.subtitle: Transforming a vertical SaaS CRM into a full operating system for movers, contributing $6M in ARR growth over two years
caseStudies.heroDescription: Partnered with the founder/CEO and VP of Product to expand SmartMoving across seven capability areas, realigning the customer base from 37% to 80% in ICP and contributing $6M in ARR growth.

challenge.title: A CRM Reputation Couldn't Support an Upmarket Move
challenge.description: SmartMoving was known industry-wide as a sales CRM for movers, but the company needed to move upmarket to serve larger operators. 63% of the customer base sat outside the ideal customer profile, consuming disproportionate support with low expansion potential.
keyProblems: Known only as a CRM, with no operational depth for larger movers
63% of customers outside the ideal customer profile
No systematic process for validating new capabilities before building them
High-cost credit card processing eating into customer margins

approach.title: ICP Realignment + AI-Native Prototyping
approach.description: Led a strategic ICP realignment through 200+ cumulative customer interviews and monthly on-site visits, while using AI to rapidly prototype and validate new capabilities before engineering was ever involved.
methodology: 200+ cumulative customer interviews and monthly on-site visits with operators to drive ICP realignment
AI-built lightweight prototypes and one-time links sent to customers to measure real usage and pain before committing engineering resources
A rapid context engine synthesizing customer sessions into structured roadmap inputs
Personal GTM execution across every new capability, including vendor negotiation and pricing

solution.title: Seven New Capability Areas Shipped as a Coherent Platform
solution.description: Expanded the platform across dispatch, claims management, analytics, automation, payments, and an open API ecosystem, telling a coherent operations-platform story instead of a collection of disconnected features.
keyFeatures: Smart Insights analytics platform with 100% paid beta retention and a national Inc. Magazine Innovation Award
Native ACH payments platform contributing over $1M in ARR
OpenAPI ecosystem generating $100K in third-party integration revenue
Embedded analytics platform sourced at 10x lower cost than the internal build estimate
Automation framework built around actual customer workflows

primaryMetrics.description: ARR growth contributed over two years
Customer mix in ideal customer profile, up from 37%
ARR contributed by the native ACH payments platform
Paid beta retention on the Smart Insights analytics platform

results.businessImpact: Repositioned SmartMoving from a niche CRM to a full operations platform for movers, directly contributing $6M in ARR growth and winning a national Inc. Magazine Innovation Award for Smart Insights.
results.customerFeedback: Larger operators who had never considered SmartMoving for their business began adopting the platform once they saw it as an operations system, not just a CRM.

learnings: AI-built prototypes validate real customer pain faster and cheaper than requirements documents
ICP realignment is a multi-year discipline, not a one-time segmentation exercise
A coherent platform story matters as much to enterprise buyers as any individual feature

caseStudies.title: Semantic Layer for Enterprise Data Security & Optimization
caseStudies.subtitle: Cutting delivery time from 3 months to 1 hour with an AI-native semantic layer scaled across 4 lines of business
caseStudies.heroMetric: 3 Months to 1 Hour Delivery + 30% Fewer Duplicate Metrics
caseStudies.heroDescription: Built a new AI-ready data security and optimization intelligence platform, using Claude Code prototyping to verify the problem and solution before committing engineering resources.

challenge.title: 8+ Teams, No Shared Way to Define the Problem
challenge.description: A gap across 8+ teams was causing confusion for enterprises trying to improve their data security and cost optimization posture, with no shared standard for defining or measuring the problem.
keyProblems: No shared definition of data security and cost optimization posture across teams
Duplicate and poorly defined metrics slowing enterprise decision-making
Manual metric delivery taking up to 3 months per request
No lightweight way to validate a solution before committing engineering resources

approach.title: Business Case, Discovery, and AI-Built Prototypes
approach.description: Built the business case from scratch, led detailed discovery, and used Claude Code to create lightweight prototypes that verified the problem and solution before engineering resources were committed.
methodology: Built the business case and led detailed discovery across 8+ affected teams
Used Claude Code to build lightweight prototypes verifying the problem and solution
Aligned engineering, design, risk, and architecture around a reusable semantic layer standard
Scaled the solution beyond the initial team investment across 4 lines of business

primaryMetrics.description: Delivery time cut for semantic layer metric requests
Reduction in duplicate and poorly defined metrics
Teams aligned around a shared standard

results.businessImpact: Turned a single-team proof of concept into a reusable semantic layer standard adopted across 4 lines of business, cutting delivery time from 3 months to 1 hour.
results.customerFeedback: Teams that previously waited months for metric definitions could self-serve consistent, trusted metrics in about an hour.

learnings: AI-built prototypes can verify enterprise problem/solution fit before engineering is ever involved
A reusable standard scales further than a single-team solution, but requires cross-functional alignment to adopt

caseStudies.title: Special Needs Student Transportation Platform
caseStudies.subtitle: Building a $1M platform from the ground up serving 1,000+ students across 10+ districts
caseStudies.heroDescription: Hand-selected to build a new vertical from the ground up, leading a 40-person contractor team to launch a $1M special needs transportation platform serving 1,000+ students across 10+ districts.

challenge.title: No Platform Existed for Special Needs Transportation
challenge.description: First Student had no platform for special needs transportation. Districts were managing complex, high-stakes logistics with fragmented tools and no operational visibility.
keyProblems: No unified platform for special needs transportation logistics
Districts relying on fragmented tools with no operational visibility
No existing relationship with district stakeholders to validate requirements

approach.title: Depot Visits, Pilot Districts, and a 40-Person Contractor Team
approach.description: Traveled to school bus depots and embedded with 3 pilot districts before writing a single requirement, then led a 40-person contractor team through full delivery with GTM alignment alongside sales and marketing.
methodology: Traveled directly to school bus depots to understand operational realities before defining requirements
Partnered with 3 pilot districts to validate the platform in real-world conditions
Led a cross-functional team of 40 contractors across engineering, operations, and external partners
Partnered with marketing and sales to define go-to-market strategy for broader district expansion

primaryMetrics.description: Contractor team led across engineering and operations

results.businessImpact: Launched a $1M platform spanning a web app and 2 mobile apps, serving 1,000+ students across 10+ districts, on time and on budget.
results.customerFeedback: District administrators reported operational visibility into special needs transportation they had never had before.

learnings: Depot-level field research surfaces operational realities that stakeholder interviews alone miss
Pilot districts validate a platform in real-world conditions before broader expansion
A 0-to-1 build benefits from GTM alignment starting on day one, not after launch
